LightningComponentBundle.description: Displays markdown documents stored as individual static resource zips (each containing doc.md and an images/ folder), using a client-side markdown renderer with sanitized HTML output.

property.name: resourceNames
property.label: Static Resource Names
property.description: Comma-separated list of static resource names, each representing a markdown document zip (with doc.md and an images/ folder).

property.name: defaultResourceName
property.label: Default Resource Name
property.description: Static resource name to show by default. If omitted or not in the list, the first resourceName will be used.

property.name: showDocumentPicker
property.label: Show Document Picker
property.description: When true, shows a combobox for users to pick which markdown document to view.
